player_prompt.intro:
Nawe ngumdlali {player_id} kule {num_rounds}-round ye-IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kulo mqondo ngamunye, tshelela inombolo phakathi kwe-{min_guess} ne-{max_guess}.
Emva kwetshelelo zombili, isibopho sikhona (2/3)x(isilinganiso sesitshelelo zombili),
ne-mdlali osesitshelelo seseduzane ne-sibopho uphumelela lomqondo.
Phendula ngetshelelo yakho ngendlela '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi ayisebenti; sicela ufake i-guess yakho njenga [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kucabanga kumele kube emkhatsini wa {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mdlali 0 utshelele {guess0}; Mdlali 1 utshelele {guess1}. Ngako-ke inombolo lenzelwe i: {target}.
